propositions: A new advisory, 1-TURN, non-codebase-grounded criterion ac-process-gate must be added to the plan-review gate to detect acceptance criteria that merely restate a generic mechanical process gate (CI pass, tests pass, children closed, plan-review pass, etc.) that CI or rebar enforces for every ticket regardless of subject.

The ac-process-gate criterion must fire (produce a finding) only on ACs whose entire completion predicate is a ticket-agnostic mechanical gate, and must pass (no finding) on ACs that name or depend on this ticket's specific deliverable (named artifact, behavior, test, config, or criterion).

The criterion must be registered in registry.CANONICAL_LLM with routing entry in criteria_routing.json carrying exec=1-TURN, default_posture=advisory, facet=ac-text-quality, and applies_at.scope=[container, leaf], with a two-key checklist (not-applicable pass and per-AC judgment).

The rubric prompt file plan_review_ac_process_gate.md must document the reject-set (children-closed, tests/CI/build/lint pass, plan-review/completion-verifier pass, merged/landed, DCO) and accept-set (ticket-specific deliverable), stating the litmus test (reads identically on unrelated ticket) and anti-false-positive rule (err toward silence).

A committed eval-spec plan-review-ac-process-gate.eval.yaml must contain at most 8 cases with at least two process-gate-AC positive and two deliverable-AC negative cases, with live bounded-sanity evaluation (recall=1.0, kappa=1.0) run and artifact committed to docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/runs/ac_process_gate_sanity.json.

Registry deterministic tests must validate canonical/1-TURN/non-grounded membership, routing parity, checklist shape, front-matter contract, guide-section regeneration, eval-spec shape, and registry.chunk_by_facet packer correction to balanced near-equal contiguous chunks without singletons.
